game_title: Parenthesis Puzzle – Ash Rim Trail Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Parenthesis Puzzle: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the magma valve.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the magma valve. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the puzzle_gap value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about puzzle_gap to power up the fire warden and open the magma valve.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Parenthesis Puzzle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parenthesis Puzzle' (Week 2 slot 9), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how puzzle_gap changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
